name: Abrahamic Prophet

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Divine Decree which establishes the limits of the created order and the scope of the prophetic office.

VINIT.justification: The unformed and void state preceding the creative word and the call of the prophet.

TANCH.justification: The final eschatological closure that terminates the prophetic mission and seals the history of the covenant.

AFWD.justification: The upward movement of the prophet to receive the heavenly decree and enter the presence of the Holy.

AREV.justification: The return of the prophet from the mountain or vision to deliver the message to the terrestrial community.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of the prophetic office where the mantle of one passes to the next.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-identification of the prophet as the mouthpiece of the Divine, recognizing their own identity within the message.

FSPLIT.justification: The single message branches into two distinct outcomes: the blessing of obedience and the curse of rebellion.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the faithful community from both the judged and the blessed, recovering the original covenant people.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative response to the prophetic word leading to restoration.

EVALF.justification: The negative response to the prophetic word leading to judgment.

ENGAGR.justification: The prophet holds the wrath of God and the guilt of the people simultaneously without resolving the tension.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the oral prophecy into an unchangeable scriptural record.

phase_3.void_description: The silence before the call where no prophetic agency exists.
phase_3.true_description: The state of alignment with the Divine Will through obedience.
phase_3.false_description: The state of exile and alienation resulting from the rejection of the word.
phase_3.both_description: The state of the prophet standing in the breach, embodying both divine pathos and human suffering.

steps.domain_action: The silence of the uncalled state before the word is spoken.
The prophet receives the call and identifies as the chosen vessel.
The prophet ascends to the Divine Council to receive the decree.
The decree is fixed in the mind of the prophet as an immutable charge.
The prophet descends from the vision to the physical community.
The prophet speaks the word, splitting the audience into two paths.
A portion of the people hears the word and turns in repentance.
A portion of the people rejects the word and hardens their hearts.
The prophet intercedes for the rebellious, holding judgment and mercy in tension.
The faithful from both paths are gathered to form the Remnant.
The Remnant carries the covenant forward to the next generation.
The entire cycle is recorded in the scroll for future witness.
The prophetic office is sealed as the message reaches its final fulfillment.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit who translates divine intent into human language.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The 'Thus says the Lord' formula which bridges the divine and human spheres.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Ark of the Covenant and the collective memory of the community.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Kairos, the appointed time for the word to be delivered.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Torah, the foundational law that serves as the bootstrap for all prophecy.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The physical and social life of the prophet, often ending in martyrdom.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A community in a state of spiritual entropy and covenantal drift.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A community restored to its foundational order through the Remnant.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The prophetic cycle restores the original covenantal order, negating the drift of history.
